quest.title: Sauro-Vet's Dilemma
quest.description: You encounter a Qucusaurus attacking a human, but there seems to be more to this scene than meets the eye...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x200, Primogem x30, Mora x35000

chapter.title: In the Footsteps of the Chosen of Dragons

dialogues.speaker: Infuriated Qucusaurus
dialogues.text: —Shwaaaargh!
Come on kiddo, come on now, quit fooling around. If you don't take your meds, you won't recover!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh no, she's in danger! We've gotta help her, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Shwrawr!"\nAs if knowing it is outmatched, the Qucusaurus flies off with a cry...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Argh, it's quick! Gone in the blink of an eye!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wha— You want Paimon to go chase it? Seriously?
...Hmm, if nothing else, it does look like it's recovered quite nicely. Next, we should...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Speaking of which, why was that Qucusaurus so mad?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Hmm, Paimon knows! You must've stolen its snacks! There's nothing more infuriating than a food thief, Paimon'll tell ya that!
Snacks? Well, yes, I've had some, but Kururuk's not the type to get in a huff over small stuff like that.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: "Kururuk"? So it has a name... Seems like it's got quite a temper on it, though! Almost hit you back there!
Well, I wouldn't blame him, the treatment being what it is...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: So taking a beating is also a kind of healing? You learn something every day...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #What? Come on, how did you get that into your head? Cut that nonsense out right now — you're giving {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} the wrong idea!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Hroowr? Rrooh?

Haha, if that was a workable form of therapy, I'd love to try it myself! Unfortunately, Saurians are different from us. Even if you told them something would help them recover quickly, there's no guarantee they'd understand.

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Ah, yes, allow me to introduce myself. I'm Mazkal. I usually take care of wounded or sick Saurians nearby. Not to brag or anything, but my medicines get pretty good client reviews.

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Hmm. Your little companion looks very healthy. Doesn't look like he needs my help.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ah, so you're a Saurian vet! Uhh, judging from the way Kururuk behaved, seems like a pretty tough job...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Oh, I wouldn't say it's all that tough. It's just that Kururuk's case is somewhat... special. He's deeply distrustful of humans right now, so he resists all treatments and medication.

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: *sigh* If only I were a Saurian myself. I've observed him, and he gets along with other Saurians just fine. Perhaps he'd be willing to take medicine if it came recommended by another Saurian.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wroo?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hmm, well if that's the case, we might just be able to help you!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Huh? Wait, you're saying that despite your appearance, you're actually Saurians!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sure have an overactive imagination! Ugh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #A—Anyway, the real reason we can do this is because {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s a super clever little Saurian! He can help us out!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Huh? He's that smart?

choices.text: Got a good eye for picking me as a companion, if nothing else...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, sure, but that's not really the focus right now, is it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Yup! Either way, you can leave this to {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, no problem!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Rawr!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: #Then on Kururuk's behalf, let me thank you in advance, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: I've been worried that if he keeps acting up like this, it might not only prevent his old injuries from healing, but even cause new wounds to emerge... So I'm most relieved to have your help!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: I've formulated two different medicines for him. I've done my best to balance therapeutic effects and palatability, but I haven't come up with the perfect solution by any means...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: The result being that the more effective of the two medicines isn't as tasty, while the one Saurians love isn't quite as effective...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: #Hmm... Well, instead of all this explaining, let's just have {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} take a sniff. You'll get the picture from how he reacts.

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Here's the more effective medicine.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Wooo... Rrroo...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: And this is the less effective, but much more appetizingly-colored one.

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, the difference really is obvious!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: No matter which one you use, the medicines will help Kururuk recover, so I'll just give you both of them. You can decide which you want to try!

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Rawr!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Hehe, you're so reliable! Anyway, I'll head back to camp to make some preparations. As for Kururuk, I leave him in your capable hands!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Don't you worry, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}'s got this!

choices.text: Smart enough to build bridges of friendship between humans and Saurians.
Running away so soon? Come back... if you dare.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You think a Saurian's gonna understand something like that!?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Might as well.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #We're counting on you for Round Two, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Chowed it right down! But...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh oh! He's even madder than before! Quick, we gotta calm him down!

dialogues.speaker: "Kururuk"
dialogues.text: Shrawr...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon's kinda worried about how Kururuk's wounds haven't fully healed yet... Why don't we follow him and see how things are?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: #You hurry over to {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and Kururuk.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There he is? Phew, at least he looks fine... Alright, let's feed him the medicine now!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Which of the two should we go with?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #If he'll eat it, this one should help him recover better, right? You've got this now, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Looks pretty hopeful. Hehe, good work, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! ...Err, wait a minute...

dialogues.speaker: "Kururuk"
dialogues.text: —Shwaaaargh!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh!? W—Was the medicine too effective? He looks even angrier than before! Gah, we've gotta calm him down real quick...

dialogues.speaker: "Kururuk"
dialogues.text: Rrooah...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is this really a Saurian who still hasn't fully recovered?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrrooo... Rawr! Rawr! Raaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He'd probably be a super tough opponent when he's in tip-top shape... Anyway, let's bring him back to Mazkal while he's being a bit more docile!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr! Raaaawr!

dialogues.speaker: Mazkal
dialogues.text: You're back! How did it go? Did Kururuk take his medicine?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, he did, but...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You explain what happened earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Mazkal
dialogues.text: I see. Alright, let me have a look... Hmm. Looks like he's fine, not hurt too badly at all.

dialogues.speaker: Mazkal
dialogues.text: Either way, it's a good thing that he took the medicine! And now that I know how he reacts, I can adjust the formula accordingly.

dialogues.speaker: Mazkal
dialogues.text: #Yup, don't worry, we should be fine. Thanks for your help — especially you, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}! What an amazing little Tepetlisaur you are!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawwr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Haha, it's nice hearing people praise {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} — even better than hearing them praise Paimon, in fact!

dialogues.speaker: Mazkal
dialogues.text: I'm impressed at how well you two get along with this little guy too. I could stand to learn a thing or two from you.

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: I'd love to say that there's something I could do to help you, or do for you...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: But I think I'll settle for wishing you the best of health. Best you never need my help!

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: Ah, right, but if you just want to chat, you're welcome to come find me anytime.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure! Hope Kururuk recovers soon — hopefully without instantly resorting to hitting people, like he did earlier...

response.speaker: Mazkal
response.text: As for that... Not to worry, I'll figure something out. And you never know, his temper might improve along with his wounds!

choices.text: #Not at all, the credit belongs to {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Well, even if this one doesn't work as well, just having him eat the medicine at all is progress enough! Let's do this, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, he snapped it right up? Hmm... But he still looks pretty listless.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wroo?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sh—Should we try the other one, then?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Let's not go with either for now.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, that does make sense... Actually, why don't we bring him back to Mazkal now that he's being a bit less rowdy?
